transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net international roaming support, my name is Oliver. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Oliver, my name is Megan Brooks. I landed at JFK Airport in New York an hour ago, but my iPhone displays 'No Service' and refuses to register on AT&T or T-Mobile, leaving me completely stranded without maps or data!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good afternoon Megan. If I understand correctly, your mobile phone is displaying 'No Service' after arriving at JFK Airport and is failing to latch onto partner cellular networks in the United States. Before we check your roaming profile, could you confirm your full UK postal address and your account security PIN?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it is 58 Park Avenue, Manchester, M14 5TP, security PIN 1192, mobile number 07700 900542.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you Megan, that confirms your account details. Let us inspect your SIM card's international roaming provisioning status immediately.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Oliver. I am using the free airport terminal Wi-Fi to make this call via Wi-Fi calling.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Could I place you on hold for two minutes while I query your international roaming provisions on the US partner gateway?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, Megan. The international gateway indicates that your domestic S-Net line has the Roam Abroad pass active, but the IMSI profile was locked to UK terrestrial bands.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Why would the IMSI profile be locked to UK frequencies?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: When traveling across international regulatory domains, the SIM sometimes caches the previous home network frequency table and fails to initiate global PLMN discovery.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you trigger a global network profile reset from your console?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, I have sent an over-the-air network profile refresh and lifted the international registration bar on your HLR record.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What manual settings should I adjust on my iPhone right now?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Please open Settings, select 'Mobile Service', and ensure that 'Data Roaming' is toggled to ON.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Checking... 'Data Roaming' is toggled to ON.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now tap 'Network Selection' and turn off the 'Automatic' slider switch.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Toggled 'Automatic' to OFF... A spinning loading wheel appeared.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The phone will scan local broadcast beacons for nearby US carrier networks.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The carrier list just populated: AT&T, T-Mobile, and Verizon.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously foreign cellular networks reject SIM authentication requests if international data roaming bolt-ons have not completed handshake negotiation.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Right, I understand the carrier handshake requirement.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Megan speaking, I just landed at JFK after an eight-hour flight, I am standing in the arrival terminal alone with three suitcases, and my phone says 'No Service'! I cannot book an Uber, I cannot message my hotel, and I cannot access my mobile banking! I am stranded in an international airport with no way to communicate and I am having a panic attack!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand how frightening and terrifying it is to be stranded at an overseas airport with no mobile signal and no way to arrange transport or reach your hotel, Megan. Please take a deep breath; you have reached the right person, and I will stay on the line with you until your phone is fully connected to the US network.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you so much Oliver, I really need to get to my hotel safely.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Please tap 'T-Mobile' on the carrier list to force registration on our primary US roaming partner.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Tapping 'T-Mobile'... The spinning icon is running...

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The gateway is processing the international diameter authentication packet.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Oliver! 'No Service' just vanished! It now displays: 'T-Mobile - 5G' with four solid signal bars!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Fantastic! Let us now verify mobile data throughput by loading an external web page with Wi-Fi turned off.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Turning off airport Wi-Fi now... Opening Safari... Loaded Google Maps instantly! It shows my exact location at Terminal 4!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now let us verify outbound voice calling by dialing our international roaming test number on +44 800 012 3456.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Dialing +44 800 012 3456... Automated voice answered immediately: 'S-Net Roaming Line Test Successful'!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That confirms voice, SMS, and high-speed 5G mobile data are all fully operational across the United States.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I just opened my Uber app and it found drivers right outside the arrivals curb!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your Roam Abroad pass gives you full access to your UK domestic data allowance of thirty gigabytes while traveling.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is incredible relief. I was so panicked standing here alone.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have documented your T-Mobile carrier registration under roaming case reference US-99182-M.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: US-99182-M, noted down.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: If your handset ever loses signal when traveling between states, keeping Network Selection on T-Mobile will ensure priority roaming.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will leave it locked to T-Mobile throughout my trip.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have also set an automated high-usage alert on your roaming profile to prevent unexpected charges.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you, that is so thoughtful and protective.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just ensuring my roaming verification ticket has your exact UK mobile number: that was 07700 900542, wasn't it?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, 07700 900542 is my number.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you Megan, all roaming records and diagnostic logs are fully updated.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: You have completely saved my trip to New York, Oliver. Thank you from the bottom of my heart.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It has been an absolute pleasure assisting you, Megan. Safe travels to your hotel.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Have a wonderful rest of your day, Oliver.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there any other mobile roaming query I can assist you with today, Megan?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No Oliver, everything is working flawlessly.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net international roaming support, Megan. Enjoy your stay in the United States. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye Oliver.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.
